mapper.sql: sbp.id, sbp.create_user_id, sbp.create_user_name, sbp.create_time, sbp.update_user_id, sbp.update_user_name, sbp.update_time as updateTime, sbp.version, sbp.is_deleted, sbp.so_id as soId, sbp.so_code as soCode, sbp.so_approve_status as soApproveStatus, sbp.so_qty as soQty, sbp.delivery_notice_id as deliveryNoticeId, sbp.delivery_notice_code as deliveryNoticeCode, sbp.delivery_notice_approve_status as deliveryNoticeApproveStatus, sbp.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, sbp.sku_id as skuId, sbp.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sbp.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sbp.frozen_time as frozenTime, sbp.frozen_qty as frozenQty, sbp.outstock_order_id as outstockOrderId, sbp.outstock_order_code as outstockOrderCode, sbp.outstock_order_type as outstockOrderType, sbp.outstock_order_status as outstockOrderStatus, sbp.outstock_order_time as outstockOrderTime, sbp.outstock_qty as outstockQty, sbp.parent_sku_id as parentSkuId, sbp.bom_version as bomVersion, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, wh.name as warehouseName, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName
mapper.select:
select
from so_b2b_processing sbp left join product_detail pd on sbp.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on sbp.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on sbp.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sbp.is_deleted = false
and sbp.outstock_order_id != ''
and sbp.frozen_qty != 0 and sbp.delivery_notice_id != '' and sbp.outstock_order_id = ''
and sbp.outstock_order_id = '' and sbp.frozen_time is not null and EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - sbp.frozen_time)) >= 7
and sbp.delivery_notice_id = '' and sbp.frozen_qty != 0
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sbp.so_id DESC,sbp.delivery_notice_id desc
